title.zh: 平面直角坐标系 · 点的地址
title.en: The coordinate plane · addresses for points

description.zh: 给平面定一个原点和互相垂直的两根数轴，每个点就有了一个先横后纵的地址 (x, y)：(3, 2) 和 (2, 3) 是两个不同的点，四个象限的符号由两根轴的正负拼成，这套地址是所有函数图像的地基。
description.en: Fix an origin and two perpendicular number lines, and every point gets an address (x, y), across first then up: (3, 2) and (2, 3) are different points, the signs in the four quadrants come from the two axes, and this address system underlies every function graph.

en: distance and midpoint between two points

label.en: Slope is built from coordinate differences

reason.zh: 斜率是 Δy/Δx：先要会读两个点的横纵坐标，才知道竖着走了多少、横着走了多少；直线和函数图像都画在这张坐标网上。
reason.en: Slope is Δy/Δx: you first have to read two points’ coordinates to know how far up and how far across; lines and function graphs are all drawn on this grid.

label.zh: 两点距离就是勾股定理
label.en: The distance between two points is Pythagoras

reason.zh: 横差 Δx 和纵差 Δy 是一个直角三角形的两条直角边，两点间的直线距离就是斜边 √(Δx² + Δy²)。
reason.en: The differences Δx and Δy are the legs of a right triangle, and the straight-line distance between the two points is its hypotenuse √(Δx² + Δy²).

label.en: An address system on the globe

reason.zh: 坐标系用两个数给平面上的点定地址；经纬网用经度、纬度两个角度给球面上的点定地址，同样是先定基准线、再报两个数。
reason.en: A coordinate system gives a point on a plane a two-number address; latitude and longitude give a point on the sphere a two-angle address — the same idea of fixing reference lines and then reporting two numbers.
